name: What is the step-by-step process of remodeling a kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process of remodeling a kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an on-site evaluation to measure the room, review structural elements, and identify where existing plumbing and electrical lines run. Once the new floor plan is drawn and cabinetry ordered, demolition clears the existing finishes. If walls are moving, custom framing takes place next, followed by mechanical rough-ins managed by specialty trades. After rough inspections, the crew handles drywall installation, taping, and texturing. Cabinetry, countertops, tile backsplashes, and finish carpentry like baseboards and crown molding are installed, concluding with interior painting and fixture trim-out.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves from planning and demolition to framing, plumbing and electrical rough-ins, drywall repair, cabinet and counter installation, tile work, and final finish trim.
